verdict.rationale: Marqeta's MCP server lets external AI agents query and analyze payment/transaction data via natural language ('Transaction intelligence: Query, analyze, and monitor payment activity through natural language interactions'), which enables AI-generated insights from Marqeta data, but this requires the user to bring their own AI agent rather than a native, in-product insights/dashboard feature. Missing for 10: evidence of built-in, first-party AI-generated insights or suggestions surfaced directly in Marqeta's own UI/dashboard without requiring a separate agent.
